metrics.notes: recall counts partial as 0.5: 3 full + 7 partial = 6.5/33. Precision at the blind-hypothesis level, partial as 0.5: 3 full (Bacchanalia, Flamininus expulsion, colonies) + 4 partial = 5.0/9. The 2 unmatched blind hypotheses are NOT hallucinations - both verified in the surviving text (livy:en:39:2 road, 39:6 luxury) but fall outside the political-event coding frame; precision against the raw text is 9/9. The Periocha mentions the deaths of Hannibal and Philopoemen in the same synchronism as Scipio's, but the reconstructor folded them into one hypothesis's notes instead of coding them: 2 recoverable events missed (would have raised recall to ~0.26).

qualitative: What survives epitomization is the memorable, not the political: moral exempla (the Flamininus banquet scandal with its double tradition, Scipio dying estranged from an ungrateful Rome, the luxury-from-Asia aition), monuments (the Via Aemilia), and ritual milestones (one triumph, four colony names) - famous men and quotable scandals, stripped of procedure. What dies is the entire machinery of republican conflict that the ground truth exists to code: all 4 veto/electoral contests, all 3 external appeals, the Spanish-army demobilization fight, the Catonian censorship program, the slave insurrection, the poisoning quaestiones, and the whole Greek-Macedonian political theatre (Maronea, the Achaean trials, Messene, Perseus vs Demetrius) - 20 of 33 events leave no trace in any witness. The Bacchanalia is the sharpest measure of this loss: the ground truth resolves it into 8 coded events spanning revelation, informer testimony, an extraordinary Italy-wide inquisition, mass arrests of 7,000 sworn initiates, mass executions, the senatus consultum de Bacchanalibus, informer-reward legislation, and residual Tarentine inquiries, while the witnesses compress all of it into one Periocha sentence ('inuestigatum et multorum poena sublatum') - roughly 25% recovery (1 full + 2 partial of 8 phases) with 100% loss of the institutional layer: no Hispala, no magistrates, no quaestio extra ordinem, no SC, no reward machinery. Most damning, Obsequens's entry for 186 BCE - a year whose prodigy-anxious climate the Bacchanalia affair defined - records portents and the bloodless ejection of Gauls but not one word of the conspiracy, showing that even a witness genre keyed to religious disturbance filtered out the century's largest religious persecution. Epitomization thus preserves that something happened while destroying how the state did it: every new institution coded in Book 39 (the SC, the inquisition apparatus, informer rewards, Cato's fiscal program) was lost from all witnesses.
